title: Matrix multiplication with exponent at most 9/4

result.label: Matrix multiplication with exponent at most 9/4
result.statement: Proves 9/4 over ℂ, giving O (n^ 9/4+ ) arithmetic operations for square matrix multiplication. In characteristic zero, some inner dimension n a with a > 0.465 permits n^ 2+o(1) rectangular multiplication. Further square bounds give ω ω < 2.371054886006746 over every fixed field.
